method.independence: Fresh native delegated leaf Verification context, separate from retrieval diagnosis author and renderer implementer. This is bounded Verification, not parent Audit or Full Audit.
method.retrieval: Actual current loopback HTTP snapshot: 24 unchanged queries, all 99 returned topic answers, 27 operator source panels and two status calls. Independently reconstructed all 152 serialized payload byte counts and SHA-256 values.
method.unchanged_result_reuse: All 24 complete search/rank/answer payloads and all 27 operator source payloads exactly match the frozen C7 snapshot. No payload metadata fields excluded. C7 adequacy judgments and their exact selected evidence are preserved; no new semantic acceptance credit.
method.current_status: Only the implementation fingerprint changed because the renderer now contains a persistent hint and aria-describedby. Reconstructed current status equals the current HTTP snapshot and 725-case evaluation fingerprints.
method.source_review: Independently checked current hashes, claimed source identities and cited locations for 357 distinct sources returned by the 99 topics and 443 distinct sources across returned topics plus the 39 miss bindings. Existing unchanged loaders reproduce complete returned payloads. This verifies binding integrity, not new exhaustive semantic source review or deployed activation.
method.integration: Renderer bytes differ from base only by one visible search-help paragraph and the input aria-describedby association. Ranking, questions, expected topics, topic text, source manifest, endpoint behavior and static CSS bytes equal base.
method.adequate: The complete returned topic content, including expandable detail, covers the question at its answerability boundary. Current-state cases require useful bounded checks and explicit inability to know unseen current state. Adequate does not imply a direct initial search snippet, a complete configuration SOP or implemented workflow verification.
method.partial: Returned material covers a material part, but an identified requested subquestion or usable triage/configuration path remains absent.
method.missing: No substantive answer to the requested intent within the top eight; lexical matches and general descriptions do not count.
method.clarity: Preserved C7 judgment: several adequate answers require lower-ranked results and expansion. Persistent hint is engineering-checked HTML only; real interaction and intended-user clarity remain unaccepted.
method.question_file_binding: Frozen question file and full canonical question-set hash verified unchanged.
method.raw_metrics: 725 current HTTP result payloads exactly equal base; 686 top-eight, 419 first, 39 misses and 725 selected-topic contract passes. No recovery or ranking gain is claimed.

limits: Known-scenario revalidation of 24 frozen questions; not an untouched holdout, measured popularity or real-user acceptance.

All 24 prior judgments are reused only after complete search, rank, returned-topic and operator-source payload identity; no payload metadata fields excluded. Current status implementation fingerprint is separately revalidated.

Coverage includes full top-eight answers and expansions. QS22 is appropriate ambiguity clarification, separate from 22 adequate substantive answers. Historical QS18 remains partial; AIM base guidance does not establish an installed replacement-LPN extension or its exact acceptance/rejection rule.

The 39 authored top-eight misses remain raw misses: 19 missing referent, 13 broad subject and 7 specific semantic subject. Context classification does not establish inherent unanswerability or excuse specific semantic retrieval gaps.
Four bounded offline ranking alternatives regress overall top-eight coverage and were rejected; this does not prove no better ranking approach exists.

Persistent search guidance and its input association were checked in actual local HTTP HTML, including no-match and missing-context pages. No browser rendering, keyboard, screen-reader or intended-user acceptance is claimed.
No new DB connection, credentials, transaction rows, operational execution, deployment, parent Audit, Full Audit or owner acceptance is part of this leaf.

cross_cutting_findings.finding: Exact replacement-LPN acceptance/rejection rule remains absent; AIM base flows and scale extension hook do not prove an installed DB extension or rejection cause.
